'''Stormtrooper Squad Aurek''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of ten [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] stationed on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The squad was formed from the remains of a larger stormtrooper [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] that was decimated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Under the command of [[347.609/D5]], they discovered an [[Unidentified Ewok village (Sector 5-7)|Ewok village]], which they [[Skirmish on Endor (Recon-A)|assaulted]].<ref name="Hammer of Destiny">''{{WEGCite|story=Terror in the Trees|book=Imperial Entanglements (Star Wars Miniatures Battles)}}''</ref>
